title: API tokens

help.usage: Send the token in the {header} header.
help.stepUp: Tokens cannot perform actions that require re-authentication.
help.audit: Requests made with a token are recorded in the audit log with the source “API”.

create.title: Generate token
create.allowedIpsHint: Optional. Limits the token to these IP addresses or CIDR ranges, for example 203.0.113.0/24.
create.intro: A token acts with your account, limited to the permissions you choose here.
create.nameHint: Say what uses it, for example “backup script”.

created.title: Copy the token {name} now
created.warning: You will not see it again. If you lose it, revoke it and generate a new one.
created.intro: Use it in the Authorization header of your requests.

confirmRevoke.title: Revoke token {name}?
confirmRevoke.content: Programs using this token will no longer be able to access the panel.

emptyText: Programs and scripts use a token to call the panel's API on your behalf.
